name: Zscaler — Web C2 Beacon (entity-mapped v2)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = zscaler_nssweblog_raw
| filter xdm.network.http.domain != null and xdm.source.host.hostname != null
| alter u_nomail = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.source.user.username, "^([^@]+)"), 0)
| alter bare_user = arrayindex(regextract(u_nomail, "([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)$"), 0)
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as callbacks by xdm.source.host.hostname, xdm.network.http.domain,
       xdm.target.ipv4, bare_user, xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter callbacks >= 8
| alter c2_ip = xdm.target.ipv4, domain = xdm.network.http.domain, beacon_user = bare_user,
        src_host = xdm.source.host.hostname, egress_ip = xdm.source.ipv4,
        app_proto = "HTTPS", c2_port = 443
| fields src_host, c2_ip, c2_port, domain, beacon_user, egress_ip, app_proto, callbacks
description: Recurring web callbacks from one device to one uncommon domain (>=8 in 30m), Zscaler NSS web log. The web log carries the Zscaler egress address rather than the client, so identity is device + normalised user; the egress address is reported separately.

TA0011 - Command and Control: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
